title: Calibration rejected: Unknown code: 12
body: Possibly related to #404. Using g5 native mode, all calibrations are rejected with this error even after a "G5 calibration requested."

comments.body: Could this be related to sensor noise? How old is the sensor?
I don't think it's related to sensor noise; the sensor was 8 days old, and had just been restarted the day before at the 7-day mark. Using an official receiver device, calibrations are accepted fine.
I had this issue even on the first calibration of the sensor.
Had this today again. No noise shown, "needs calibration" in system Status. Same unknown Code on calibration.
I believe this should be resolved now.

@jwoglom Would you please close this issue if it has been resolved?
Thanks
